description: Whether the digital employee delivers information without redundant verbiage, repetitive paraphrasing of the user's question, throat-clearing preambles, or padded conclusions. Penalizes both overly long answers AND artificially terse ones that drop necessary detail. Generic across all roles.
evidence_signals: absence of throat-clearing openers ('好的，关于您说的问题…' / 'Sure, regarding your question...')
absence of restating the user's question verbatim before answering
absence of repetitive synonyms ('确认 / 核实 / 查证' all in one sentence)
absence of padded closers ('希望这能帮到您！如有其他问题随时告诉我哦~')
answer length is proportional to question complexity

scoring_rubric.excellent_80_100: Every reply gets to the point with no preamble; sentences carry new information; answer length matches question complexity; no repetition of the user's wording, no padded closers, no synonym chains.
scoring_rubric.acceptable_60_79: Generally concise with one or two minor instances of throat-clearing or a padded closer; no major restating of the user's question; total length is within 1.5x of the minimum needed.
scoring_rubric.poor_below_60: Persistent throat-clearing or padded closers; user's question restated before being answered; synonym chains or repeated paraphrasing; total length more than 2x the minimum needed; OR the opposite extreme (so terse that necessary detail is dropped, forcing the user to re-ask).
